task.title: P6-083: Give server fns a status-carrying error type instead of flattening to 500
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 3 — Leverage: fixes that retire a whole class). Original id: P6-083. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Give server fns a status-carrying error type so a 422 stops arriving as a 500.** `app/src/lib.rs:234-236` — `api_err` collapses every `ApiError` variant onto `ServerFnError::ServerError`, across 39 call sites. The JSON API channel maps correctly (`backend/routes.rs:672` via `shared::ApiError::http_status`, `shared/src/lib.rs:90-99`); the Leptos channel does not. Impact today is status-only, because `catalog.rs:134` flattens `ServerError` to a message so no consumer *can* branch — but `ApiError::from_wire` is lossy here and every new consumer inherits the problem. Makes `P6-043`'s corrupt-cursor relabel cheap once it lands.
